query:
DELETE FROM subscriptions
            WHERE id = $1
                AND (
                    $2::BIGINT IS NULL
                    OR requester_user_id = $2
                    OR (
                        target_user_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $3::BIGINT
                        AND target_channel IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $4::TEXT
                        AND target_topic IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $5::TEXT
                    )
                )
